reviewer: Fable 5.1, plan lead. Chromium 151.0.7922.34 driven by Playwright 1.62.1, headless, against a local gateway built from the reviewed source.
source_state: Branch csp18-site-a11y at c9b81f9aa55d1b95c2b8cd79c36d0c86014aca20, six commits over feb5934a (the slice 2 head of PR #410). The worktree was clean and the remote head was equal. The reviewed gateway was built with make build from this head. Lead checks at this head: pnpm -C console check (83 files, 539 tests), the 8 verify scripts, make lint, go test ./internal/console/... ./internal/server/..., and make build all exit 0. The slice lands on main through a squash merge, so the merged commit differs from source_head; the merge proof records it. The input hashes identify the reviewed files.
method: review-script.mjs in this directory ran against the open gateway and the guarded gateway. Each observation records its measured evidence in measurements.json.

evidence.themes: Three pages (home, troubleshoot/recovery, search) at 1280x900 under both color schemes. Each page applied the emulated theme. Rendered text contrast against the painted background: 453 samples per theme, minimum 5.9:1 in dark (dt 'Release', 14 px) and 4.92:1 in light (link 'Start', 14 px). The version selector opens in both themes and its chevron rotates.
evidence.reflow_320: At 320x640 in both themes, scrollWidth equals 320 on all three pages, with and without the text-spacing overrides. No element wider than the viewport.
evidence.zoom: 200%: 640 px layout at device scale 2, no overflow. 400%: 320 px layout at device scale 4, clientWidth, scrollWidth, and body scrollWidth all 320, no wide element.
evidence.text_spacing: Line height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2 em, letter spacing 0.12 em, word spacing 0.16 em at 1280 and 320: no clipped text, no overflow, no horizontal scroll on any of the three pages.
evidence.keyboard: The skip link is the first Tab stop, visible on focus, and moves focus to #content. 60 focus stops on the recovery topic, each with a 2 px solid outline in the accent #f0b23e. Code blocks scroll in a focusable group with an accessible name; keyboard scrolling moved an overflowing block by 57 px.
evidence.screen_reader: ARIA snapshots of the three pages (aria-snapshots.txt): one banner, one main, one contentinfo, named navigation and search landmarks, one h1 per page, and no unlabelled control.
evidence.fragments: Fresh cross-document loads and reloads in place of #steps and #coordinated-recovery land 32 px below the sticky header: top 141 under header bottom 109 at 1024, 99 under 67 at 1280, 89 under 57 at 1440. #related-settings lands at 611 at the page end. At 320 the same fragments land at top 16 before and after a reload.
evidence.sticky_columns_page_end: At the end of the recovery topic in a 900 px viewport, the sticky navigation column stays 16 px below the header: top 125 under header bottom 109 at 1024, 83 under 67 at 1280, 73 under 57 at 1440. The table of contents matches at 1280 and 1440. The first navigation link takes focus fully in view (44 px tall) at every width. The footer is 80 px at the page bottom.
evidence.history: Two table of contents links, then back and forward: the address hash and the current-section marker agree at each step across 14 entries.
evidence.stable_version_links: The version selector lists the current build ('dev (this build)', aria-current=true, href ../../) and the link resolves with 200.
evidence.reduced_motion: With prefers-reduced-motion, scroll-behavior is auto and the link and summary transitions are 0 s.
evidence.static_docs_without_session: 26 requests on the open gateway, all to the gateway's own /docs/ assets, no API call, no request outside the origin, no cookie, empty local and session storage, and the embedded search returned 20 hits for the recovery topic.
evidence.protected_routes_remain_guarded: On the guarded gateway without a session, the recovery topic answers 200 and /api/v1/models answers 401; the other probes answer 404.

limitations: Recorded review, not repeated by the verifier. The verifier checks this record, the input hashes, and the capture hashes.
The Chrome extension was not connected. The review used Chromium 151.0.7922.34 through Playwright 1.62.1 in headless mode. No other engine or assistive technology was run.

Reload after a window resize: in 2 of 10 trials, Chromium's history scroll restoration landed after restoreFragment and left the fragment at the clamped old position. A fresh load of the fragment address and a reload in place were stable in every trial. The record measures those flows.
h3 renders at 18 px, below the 20 px heading target that applies to h2 section headings.
On an archived version page, the version selector lists only that build. The review ran against a dev build, whose selector lists one entry.
The sticky columns reserve the measured footer height below their maximum height at every scroll position, so the navigation shows up to 80 px less content before its own scroll.
